'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Donbas (2022)|Battle of Donbas]]
****[[Russian forces]] launch [[airstrike]]s on the city of [[Kramatorsk]], in [[Donetsk Oblast]], with casualties reported, according to the city's mayor. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-city-kramatorsk-hit-by-air-strike-casualties-reported-mayor-2022-07-07/ (Reuters)]
***Russia says that it fired missiles at [[Snake Island (Ukraine)|Snake Island]], killing an unspecified number of [[Ukrainian Army|Ukrainian troop]]s. However, [[Ukraine]] denies that any casualties have occurred. [https://www.standard.co.uk/news/world/russia-targets-snake-island-missiles-after-ukraine-raises-flag-b1010778.html (''Evening Standard'')]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**One person is killed and four others injured in a [[hand grenade]] attack at a police post in [[Mardan District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-pakistan-police-peshawar-19098535a6f5aea07ee23fe79033f693 (AP)]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**Suspected [[Allied Democratic Forces]] fighters kill at least thirteen people after they burn a clinic to the ground in [[North Kivu]], [[DRC]]. Three of the attackers are killed by the army. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/militiamen-kill-least-nine-patients-east-congo-clinic-2022-07-08/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/africa-dido-ba84ba4f9fd604d41a02adfbc424b779 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2019–present Sri Lankan economic crisis]]
**According to the [[UN]]'s [[World Food Programme]], nearly six million people in [[Sri Lanka]] are currently suffering from [[food insecurity]] caused by the worst economic crisis that the country has experienced since 1948. [https://www.wionews.com/south-asia/crisis-hit-nearly-6-million-sri-lankans-experience-food-insecurity-as-inflation-rises-495155 (WION)]
*The government of [[Laos]] discusses the purchase of oil from sanctions-hit [[Russia]] as the country faces oil shortages and is nearing a debt default. [https://markets.businessinsider.com/news/commodities/energy-fuel-shortage-laos-buy-cheap-russian-oil-debt-default-2022-7 (''Business Insider'')]
*The [[Central Bank of Ireland]] announces that inflation will exceed 10% for the first time since the early 1980s. [https://www.irishtimes.com/business/2022/07/07/inflation-to-go-above-10-central-bank-warns/ (''The Irish Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Nine people are killed and 43 others injured when a bus from [[Sudan]] crashes while travelling to [[Aswan]], [[Egypt]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nine-killed-including-five-sudanese-bus-crash-southern-egypt-2022-07-07/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Europe]]
***[[Slovakia]] reports its first case of monkeypox. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/slovakia-confirms-first-case-monkeypox-public-health-authority-2022-07-07/ (Reuters)]
**[[Ecuador]], the [[Dominican Republic]] and [[Jamaica]] report their first cases of [[monkeypox]]. [https://english.news.cn/20220707/4c640f39acf4474c8c7fb3bcfd71c392/c.html (Xinhua News Agency)] [https://sports.yahoo.com/dominican-republic-confirms-first-case-001820656.html (Yahoo!)] [https://www.caribbeannationalweekly.com/caribbean-breaking-news-featured/jamaica-records-first-case-of-monkeypox/ (''Caribbean National Weekly'')] 
**Two new deaths from monkeypox are reported in endemic countries in [[Africa]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/7/who-reports-two-new-monkeypox-deaths-and-cases-in-new-areas (Al Jazeera)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
***The [[Government of Hong Kong]] announce that they will put on hold a flight suspension mechanism, allowing airlines to continue to fly into Hong Kong even if positive cases have been detected on their flights when entering Hong Kong previously. [https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1656626-20220707.htm (RTHK)]
*Authorities in [[Cuba]] say that [[dengue fever]] cases have increased 21.7% from last year and describe the epidemiological situation as "complex". [https://www.infobae.com/america/agencias/2022/07/07/cuba-bate-record-de-focos-de-dengue-y-califica-el-escenario-como-complejo/ (Infobae)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mexico–United States border crisis]]
**[[Governor of Texas]] [[Greg Abbott]] authorizes the [[United States National Guard]] to return migrants along the [[Mexico–United States border]] in [[Texas]] to [[Mexico]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-texas-immigration-greg-abbott-2fed811c68d49951a45d72fd1898ce0f (AP)]
*American basketball player [[Brittney Griner]] pleads guilty to [[Crime in Russia#Drug trafficking|drug charge]]s in a Russian courtroom and faces up to 10 years in prison. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/07/07/europe/brittney-griner-russia-pleads-guilty/index.html (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[July 2022 United Kingdom government crisis|2022 United Kingdom government crisis]]
**[[Secretary of State for Education|Education Secretary]] [[Michelle Donelan]] resigns 36 hours after being appointed to the post. A total of 61 ministers and aides have now resigned. [https://news.sky.com/story/nadhim-zahawi-tells-boris-johnson-you-must-do-the-right-thing-and-go-now-12647338 (Sky News)]
**[[Boris Johnson]] resigns as the leader of the [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative Party]] but plans to remain [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] until [[July 2022 Conservative Party leadership election|a new leader is elected]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-62076257 (BBC News)]
*The [[House of Representatives (Cyprus)|Cypriot House of Representatives]] approves the seventeenth amendment to the [[Constitution of Cyprus]], which involves a reform of the judiciary, the recovery of the [[Supreme Constitutional Court of Cyprus]] and the creation of the [[Court of Appeal of Cyprus]]. [https://cyprus-mail.com/2022/07/07/house-passes-legislation-that-paves-way-for-justice-reform/ (''Cyprus Mail'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 Wimbledon Championships]]
**[[Tunisia]]n tennis player [[Ons Jabeur]] becomes both the first African and first Arab player to reach the final of a [[Grand Slam (tennis)|Grand Slam]] tournament after defeating [[Tatjana Maria]] in the semifinals of the 2022 [[The Championships, Wimbledon|Wimbledon]] [[2022 Wimbledon Championships – Women's singles|women's singles]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2022/jul/07/ons-jabeur-first-arab-african-woman-grand-slam-final-wimbledon-tatjana-maria-tennis (''The Guardian'')]
